# Real BMI — Evidence-Based Health & Fitness Calculators

> Real BMI provides free, evidence-based health, metabolic, and body composition calculators based on official World Health Organization (WHO) and Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) standards. All mathematical calculations run client-side in the browser with 100% data privacy and zero server storage.

## Language Hubs
- [Real BMI English Hub](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/): Free BMI, BMR, TDEE, body fat, and wellness calculators in English.
- [Real BMI Spanish Hub](https://realbmicalculator.com/es/): Free BMI, BMR, TDEE, body fat, and wellness calculators in Spanish.
- [Real BMI French Hub](https://realbmicalculator.com/fr/): Free BMI, BMR, TDEE, body fat, and wellness calculators in French.

## Complete Suite of 23 Evidence-Based Calculators
- [Free BMI Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/bmi-calculator/): Calculate Body Mass Index quickly with WHO-based health categories and instant privacy-first results.
- [3D BMI Calculator & Body Visualizer](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/3d-bmi-calculator/): Interactive 3D avatar visualization studio comparing Quetelet standard BMI and Nick Trefethen's Oxford 2.5 exponent formula.
- [Adult BMI Reference Chart](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/bmi-chart/): Complete WHO classification reference table detailing underweight, normal weight, pre-obesity, and obesity classes I-III.
- [BMI Calculator for Indians (ICMR)](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/bmi-calculator-for-indians/): Population-specific South Asian cutoffs endorsed by ICMR with overweight at ≥ 23.0 kg/m² and obesity at ≥ 25.0 kg/m².
- [Asian BMI Calculator (WHO WPRO)](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/asian-bmi-calculator/): WHO Western Pacific region criteria for East and Southeast Asian adults with overweight at 23.0 kg/m² and obesity at 27.5 kg/m².
- [Healthy Weight by Height Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/healthy-weight-by-height/): Compute exact healthy target weight boundaries corresponding to normal BMI 18.5–24.9 kg/m² across metric and imperial heights.
- [Accurate BMR Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/bmr-calculator/): Determine basal metabolic resting calorie burn using the clinical Mifflin-St Jeor formula and legacy Harris-Benedict comparison.
- [TDEE Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/tdee-calculator/): Compute total daily energy expenditure by pairing resting basal rate with physical activity multipliers from sedentary to extreme athletic conditioning.
- [Maintenance Calorie Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/maintenance-calorie-calculator/): Identify exact daily caloric equilibrium to maintain current body weight and stable body composition.
- [US Navy Body Fat Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/body-fat-calculator/): Calculate body fat percentage and fat-free mass using validated US Navy circumference formulas for men and women.
- [Lean Body Mass Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/lean-body-mass-calculator/): Estimate fat-free mass using validated clinical Boer, James, and Hume anthropometric equations.
- [Ideal Body Weight Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/ideal-weight-calculator/): Evaluate healthy target body weight across peer-reviewed clinical equations: Devine (1974), Robinson (1983), Miller (1983), and Hamwi (1964).
- [Calorie Target Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/calorie-calculator/): Plan structured caloric deficits for fat loss or caloric surpluses for lean muscle gain based on individual energy expenditure.
- [Daily Protein Intake Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/protein-intake-calculator/): Calculate evidence-based daily protein targets (0.8 to 2.2 g/kg) according to activity level, body composition goals, and age.
- [Daily Water Intake Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/water-intake-calculator/): Compute daily fluid hydration targets incorporating baseline body weight, physical exertion, and climate factors.
- [Macro Split Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/macro-calculator/): Distribute daily caloric intake across carbohydrates, proteins, and dietary fats for balanced, low-carb, keto, or athletic performance protocols.
- [Waist-to-Hip Ratio Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/waist-to-hip-ratio-calculator/): Assess visceral adiposity and cardiovascular health risks using WHO waist-to-hip and waist-to-height ratio standards.
- [Body Surface Area Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/body-surface-area-calculator/): Estimate body surface area (m²) via Mosteller, Du Bois, and Haycock clinical formulas for physiological and metabolic assessment.
- [Target Heart Rate Zone Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/heart-rate-zone-calculator/): Determine 5 distinct aerobic and anaerobic cardiovascular training zones based on age-predicted maximum heart rate.
- [Karvonen Heart Rate Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/karvonen-heart-rate-calculator/): Calculate individualized heart rate training zones using the Karvonen formula incorporating heart rate reserve (HRR) and resting heart rate.
- [One Rep Max (1RM) Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/1rm-calculator/): Safely estimate maximal strength capacity for bench press, squat, and deadlift using validated Epley, Brzycki, Lander, and Lombardi formulas.
- [Pregnancy Weight Gain Calculator](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/pregnancy-weight-gain-calculator/): Track trimester-specific gestational weight gain curves according to Institute of Medicine (IOM) pre-pregnancy BMI guidelines.
- [Type 2 Diabetes Risk Calculator (FINDRISC)](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/diabetes-risk-calculator/): Non-invasive Finnish Diabetes Risk Score evaluating age, BMI, waist circumference, physical activity, and diet.

## In-Depth Guides & Clinical Resources
- [BMI Chart for Men and Women](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/bmi-chart-for-men-women/): Understand BMI ranges, health categories, and body composition differences across sexes.
- [Healthy BMI Range for Indians](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/healthy-bmi-range-indians/): Learn healthy BMI ranges and culturally relevant guidance for Indian body types.
- [BMI Calculator for Teens](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/bmi-calculator-teens/): Discover teen-specific BMI guidance and wellness planning for younger bodies.
- [BMR vs TDEE Calculator Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/bmr-vs-tdee-calculator/): Deep dive into resting metabolic expenditure versus total active calorie burn.
- [How to Calculate TDEE](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/how-to-calculate-tdee/): Step-by-step guidance on calculating energy expenditure with activity multipliers.
- [BMR Formulas: Mifflin vs Harris-Benedict](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/bmr-formulas-mifflin-vs-harris-benedict/): Mathematical comparison of modern and legacy basal metabolic formulas.
- [Healthy Calorie Deficit Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/healthy-calorie-deficit-guide/): Evidence-based sustainable fat loss strategies without muscle degradation.
- [Daily Protein Intake Science](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/daily-protein-intake-science/): Clinical recommendations for protein consumption across sedentary, athletic, and elderly demographics.
- [Macro Split Calculator Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/macro-split-calculator-guide/): Balanced macronutrient distribution for wellness, athletic performance, and metabolic health.
- [Daily Water Intake Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/daily-water-intake-guide/): Optimal hydration science according to climate, body weight, and workout intensity.
- [Body Surface Area Mosteller Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/body-surface-area-mosteller-guide/): Physiological applications and calculation of body surface area.
- [Target Heart Rate Training Zones](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/target-heart-rate-training-zones/): Cardiovascular zone training with the Karvonen formula and heart rate reserve.
- [One Rep Max Strength Guide](https://realbmicalculator.com/en/blog/one-rep-max-strength-guide/): Submaximal repetition algorithms for calculating maximum strength output safely.
